description: She wears a muted burgundy floor-length gown with a square neckline and elbow-length sleeves, decorated with narrow gold woven borders and round shoulder brooches. A gold-patterned belt gathers the waist. An ivory wrap with burgundy-and-gold edging drapes loosely around her forearms, and a light underdress appears through the low walking opening. Brown closed shoes and small hanging earrings are visible. Her head is bare.
